NAPLES, Fla. and McLEAN, Va., Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire-PRWeb/ -- Hilton (
) today announced the signing of Naples Grande Beach Resort, which will join the Signia Hilton portfolio as

params.linkText: Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort

children: . The signing is part of the brand's strong growth trajectory and continued expansion into irreplaceable destinations, signaling a new chapter in Signa Hilton's evolution into luxury destinations for travelers pursuing their ambitions, passions and celebrations. The 474-room resort, inclusive of 50 villas, will become the first Signia Hilton on Florida's Gulf Coast, introducing the brand's distinctive luxury experience to one of the country's most sought-after destinations. Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort is now accepting reservations on Hilton.com for stays beginning January 1, 2027.

As we join Signia Hilton, we're building on that legacy with a thoughtfully reimagined resort that offers even more opportunities to relax, celebrate and connect. Welcoming returning guests and introducing new travelers to a Naples Grande experience that feels both familiar and entirely new.

Currently undergoing the most significant transformation in its nearly four-decade history, Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort is being reimagined through a comprehensive resort-wide renovation set to redefine the guest experience. Updates will introduce redesigned guest rooms and suites, vibrant culinary offerings, destination-inspired experiences, premium wellness amenities, dynamic social and gathering spaces that encourage guest connection, along with Signia Hilton's warm, anticipatory service.

Upon its debut in January 2027, Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort will expand Signia Hilton's presence in Florida as its third property in the state, joining Signia by Hilton Orlando Bonnet Creek and Signia by Hilton Diplomat Beach Resort, while further strengthening Hilton's portfolio of more than 540 hotels statewide.

"We're looking forward to welcoming Naples Grande Beach Resort into the Signia Hilton portfolio, marking an exciting step in our strong brand growth and continued expansion into premier resort destinations," said Meghan Fitzgerald, global brand leader, Signia Hilton. "Naples is one of Florida's most coveted coastal destinations, and this resort provides an exceptional backdrop for the hallmarks of the Signia Hilton experience, offering guests a distinctive setting to connect, celebrate, discover and immerse themselves in the best of Florida's Gulf Coast."

Defined by natural beauty, leisure and refinement, Naples has earned a reputation as one of Florida's leading luxury destinations, attracting visitors who return year after year. Set along three miles of Gulf Coast beach, including the mangrove forests of Clam Pass, and just minutes from downtown Naples, Waterside Shops and the cultural attractions of Florida's Paradise Coast, the resort will include a luxury spa, multiple pools, championship tennis and a versatile collection of indoor and outdoor gathering spaces designed to accommodate events of varying sizes, creating an exceptional retreat for leisure travelers, groups, weddings and special events alike.

"For generations, guests have chosen Naples Grande for its extraordinary setting, expansive amenities and genuine sense of hospitality," said Gary Sims, managing director, Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort. "As we join Signia Hilton, we're building on that legacy with a thoughtfully reimagined resort that offers even more opportunities to relax, celebrate and connect. We look forward to welcoming returning guests and introducing new travelers to a Naples Grande experience that feels both familiar and entirely new."
To celebrate its debut,

Members who book directly have access to instant benefits, including a flexible payment slider that allows members to choose nearly any combination of Points and money to book a stay, an exclusive member discount, free standard Wi-Fi, and the Hilton Honors mobile app.
To learn more about Signia Hilton, visit stories.hilton.com/signia.

About Naples Grande Beach Resort

Set among lush mangrove forests on Florida's Paradise Coast, Naples Grande Beach Resort is a 474-room retreat offering direct access to three miles of white sand beach. The iconic beachfront resort is currently undergoing a transformative, property-wide revitalization that will debut in early 2027, ushering in a new era of modern coastal luxury. The comprehensive reimagination will refresh guest accommodations, dining venues, public spaces and select meetings and event offerings while honoring the timeless beauty and natural surroundings of Naples. The resort features an extensive collection of indoor and outdoor meeting and event space, multiple dining outlets and a full-service spa, making it a premier destination for leisure travelers, groups and special events. For more information, visit www.naplesgrande.com.
About Signia Hilton

Signia Hilton is a portfolio of world-class hotels that infuse sophisticated travel and luxurious experiences into every aspect of the guest stay. Each Signia Hilton hotel offers distinctive design, signature food and beverage experiences, intentional wellness offerings and unparalleled meetings and events capabilities, all backed by the Hilton name and award-winning Hilton Honors program. Experience Signia Hilton by booking at signiahilton.com or through the industry-leading Hilton Honors app. Hilton Honors members who book directly through preferred Hilton channels have access to instant benefits. Learn more about Signia Hilton at stories.hilton.com/signia.
